item.title: City-Parish reaches condemnation milestone Monday, Mayor celebrates demolition
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Mayor-President Sid Edwards jumped back in the seat of an excavator Monday morning to tear down the parish's 200th condemned property in 2025.&nbsp;Edwards operated the machinery to remove the blight along Comish Drive in Baton Rouge. item.title: Dunham students celebrate state title during pep rally
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Students celebrated "The Dunham School Day" on Monday following Dunham's football state championship.&nbsp;The Dunham Tigers beat Calvary Baptist 34-17 to win the LHSAA Division III state title. The win served as the program's first state title since 2004 and the team was the only one from the Baton Rouge area to reach a state title game this season.Mayor-President Sid Edwards declared Monday, Dec. 15 as "The Dunham School Day" ahead of the celebration. item.title: Man arrested for allegedly running person over, breaking both their legs
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; A Baton Rouge man was arrested for allegedly running someone over and breaking both of their legs, according to the Baton Rouge Police Department.&nbsp;Recco Spears, 32, is accused of running a man over outside a Byron Avenue home near Plank Road on Friday.An arrest affidavit says security footage shows Spears driving very fast and hitting the man before driving through two fences and crashing into an ice cream truck. item.title: Car catches fire outside Denham Springs store
item.description: DENHAM SPRINGS - Firefighters responded to a car engulfed in flames in the parking lot of a Denham Springs store on Monday.&nbsp;WBRZ received video of the blaze, which showed the vehicle on fire outside of the O'Reilly Auto Parts along South Range Avenue.&nbsp;People in the area reported hearing loud booms and feeling vibrations before seeing the vehicle on fire.&nbsp;Sources said no injuries were reported and the cause of the fire is still under investigation.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Belle River Bridge closed to boat traffic, boat parade adjusted
item.description: PIERRE PART - The Belle River Bridge is closed to boat traffic until further notice, Assumption Parish law enforcement said Monday.&nbsp;The Assumption Parish Sheriff's Office said the water level is too low and causing operational issues.&nbsp;The boat parade, scheduled for Saturday, will now start at Graveyard Island and end at the Belle River Bridge instead of traveling on to Bayou Godell.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Louisiana settles two lawsuits with pharmacy giant; independent druggists react
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; A long-running legal dispute between the state and CVS, a major pharmacy chain, over the role of pharmacy benefit managers in Louisiana may soon be resolved with settlements.The conflict accelerated when CVS sent messages to customers warning about state legislation that would ban pharmacy benefit managers from owning retail pharmacies. item.title: One arrested in Port Allen after chase ends in crash
item.description: PORT ALLEN - One person was taken into custody Monday night after leading deputies on a chase and crashing their car.&nbsp;The West Baton Rouge Parish Sheriff's Office said deputies tried to stop the vehicle along U.S. 190 and the driver did not stop.&nbsp;Deputies chased the vehicle, which crashed while getting off the highway onto La. 415.&nbsp;The driver, who has not been identified, will be taken to a medical facility before being booked into the West Baton Rouge Parish Detention Center.&nbs
